ward.summary: Dongri, Masjid Bunder (ward B) used ₹35.1 lakh of its ₹43.0 lakh budget, or 82%, and stayed within budget. Of 44 jobs, 20% were redone within 30 days, in line with the 22% expected for similar work, though ₹5.8 lakh went on repairs that failed. On-time completion was 57% against 47% expected. Five jobs are listed for review, and three jobs, worth ₹1.7 lakh, were paid on roads under warranty. Next, the ward should fund its 9 open issues, costing ₹3.9 lakh, starting with Mohammed Ali Road, P D'Mello Road and Nishanpada Road. The remaining ₹7.9 lakh covers all of them.
